messages:
Olivia: Heads-up — Vizlytics posted an incident advisory about a possible API key leakage. Link: https://status.vizlytics.example/incident/489. Do we have any keys there?

Vizlytics-Status: INCIDENT 489: temporary public exposure of API keys in a debug log. Recommendation: rotate keys, invalidate older tokens, review access logs. ETA remediation ~2h.

Raja: We do have one integration: analytics-ingest-prod using a secret stored in Secrets Manager (vizlytics/prod). I'll start rotation and report task ID.

Bernard: On standby. I'll create a network block for outbound calls to Vizlytics from prod and pull CloudTrail + S3 access logs.

Olivia: Containment plan: @Raja rotate the key immediately, @Bernard block egress to vizlytics endpoints, @Tia legal/comms standby. Triage: confirm token scope and which envs use it.

Raja: Token scope = org:analytics-ingest only (no DB writes). Still treat as compromised. Command I'm running now: 
```
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id vizlytics/prod --secret-string '{"api_key":"<NEW_KEY>"}' 
aws secretsmanager update-secret-version-stage --secret-id vizlytics/prod --remove-from-version-id <OLD_VERSION_ID> --stage-name AWSCURRENT
```
Will roll through instances after creation.

SRE-Bot: deploy-bot: firewall rule 'block-vizlytics-egress' created in prod-vpc by Bernard at 1769997805.

Bernard: Quick triage: CloudTrail shows 3 calls from prod to /v1/ingest in last 24h, payloads look normal (metrics only). No sign of customer PII in payloads. Saving logs to /ops/incidents/vizlytics/1769997777.zip.

Olivia: :thumbsup: Raja, once rotated invalidate the old secret and update all consumers. Trigger a repo scan for leaked keys (repo-scan job).

Raja: Rotation underway. New secret created: vizlytics/prod@rot-176999; invalidation of old version in progress. Repo-scan enqueued: https://ci.redwood.example/job/repo-scan/2026-122.

Tia: Legal here — preparing a statement. Please collect timeline + list of affected services and any customer impact. If impact is >P0, we'll notify customers. Keep me posted.

Vizlytics-Status: UPDATE: we've rotated impacted partner keys on our side. We strongly recommend all partners rotate immediately. Full postmortem scheduled.

Olivia: Next actions for post-incident: run a full history search for hardcoded Vizlytics tokens across commits, migrate this secret to KMS-wrapped Secrets Manager with automatic rotation, add alerting for vendor status page incidents. I'll open follow-up tickets.

Raja: Note for follow-up: migrate vizlytics/prod to KMS key alias/aws/secrets/redwood-vizlytics and enable rotation. Created tracking ticket: https://boards.redwood.example/board/SEC/3456.

Bernard: Containment status: egress block stays until rotation verified and 1h of clean logs. Uploading logs to shared drive now.

SRE-Bot: incident-bot: incident 2026-03-20-vizlytics created, severity=medium, owner=Olivia.

Olivia: Thanks all — I'll coordinate the postmortem and send a summary to #security once we have the timeline and artifacts.
